method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: methotrexate early rheumatoid arthritis combination therapy TEAR
topic.coverageNote: Early-RA methotrexate strategies in TEAR: immediate combination, step-up at DAS28-ESR ≥3.2, and the primary equivalence of etanercept-methotrexate versus triple therapy.

mcqs.question: Who was eligible for TEAR?

options.A: Adults with RA by 1987 criteria, disease duration under 3 years, and active disease
options.B: Only patients with more than 10 years of disease
options.C: Patients who had already failed two biologic drugs
options.E: Patients in DAS28 remission at entry

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Adults with RA by 1987 criteria, disease duration under 3 years, and active disease
mcqs.explanation: Entry required disease duration under 3 years from diagnosis, age over 18, 1987 ACR criteria, and active disease with at least 4 swollen and 4 tender joints.

sourceRefs.excerpt: entry criteria included disease duration < 3 years from the time of diagnosis; age over 18 years; RA diagnosis by the 1987 ACR criteria

mcqs.question: What methotrexate schedule did every participant follow?

options.A: Oral methotrexate escalated to 20 mg weekly by week 12, or a lower dose if the joints were already inactive
options.B: A fixed 7.5 mg weekly dose for two years
options.D: Methotrexate was withheld in the etanercept arm
options.E: Methotrexate was added only after week 48

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Oral methotrexate escalated to 20 mg weekly by week 12, or a lower dose if the joints were already inactive
mcqs.explanation: All participants received oral methotrexate, escalated to 20 mg per week, or a lower dose if it produced no active tender or swollen joints, by week 12.

sourceRefs.excerpt: All participants received oral MTX, escalated to 20 mg/wk, or a lower dose if it resulted in no active tender/painful or swollen joints, by Week 12.

mcqs.question: When was step-up therapy added in the initial-methotrexate arms?

options.A: At week 24 if DAS28-ESR was 3.2 or higher

mcqs.correctAnswerText: At week 24 if DAS28-ESR was 3.2 or higher
mcqs.explanation: Participants who started on methotrexate stepped up to etanercept, or to sulfasalazine plus hydroxychloroquine, if DAS28-ESR was at least 3.2 at week 24.

sourceRefs.excerpt: initial MTX, with step-up treatment adding ETN if DAS28-ESR was ≥ 3.2 at week 24

mcqs.question: What was the primary comparison of etanercept plus methotrexate versus oral triple therapy?

options.A: No difference between the two treatment approaches
options.B: Etanercept was superior on the primary outcome
options.C: Triple therapy was superior on the primary outcome
options.D: The primary outcome could not be analysed
options.E: Methotrexate monotherapy was superior to both combinations

mcqs.correctAnswerText: No difference between the two treatment approaches
mcqs.explanation: TEAR is described as the only randomized double-blind comparison of oral triple DMARD therapy with etanercept plus methotrexate, and the primary outcome revealed no difference between the two approaches.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The primary outcome revealed no differences between the two treatment approaches.

mcqs.question: Which week-102 difference does the paper report as the only significant treatment difference?

options.A: ACR70 of 18.2% with etanercept versus 11.3% with triple therapy (p=0.02)
options.B: A large DAS28 difference favouring triple therapy
options.C: Modified HAQ was worse with etanercept
options.D: Radiographic remission only in the placebo arm
options.E: No week-102 comparison was statistically significant

mcqs.correctAnswerText: ACR70 of 18.2% with etanercept versus 11.3% with triple therapy (p=0.02)
mcqs.explanation: The only significant treatment difference at week 102 was ACR70, 18.2% in the etanercept group versus 11.3% in the triple-therapy group (p=0.02). Function improved similarly across groups.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the only significant treatment difference at week 102 was between the ETN and triple therapy groups for ACR70 (18.2% vs. 11.3%, p=0.02).
